create_encoding_stage: create an EncodingStage instance with a ParallelTiledVAE model for pixel-to-latent encoding
verify_input_batch: verify that a Req batch has valid 5D tensor latents for VAE encoding input
verify_output_batch: verify that a Req batch has valid 5D tensor latents after VAE encoding output
run_encoding_forward: run the encoding stage forward pass to encode pixel-space video into latent space
encode_pixel_to_latent: encode pixel-space images or video into latent space with VAE tiling and autocast precision
